name: Amiflamine
summary: Amiflamine (developmental code name FLA-336), also known (S)-2-methyl-4-(dimethylamino)amphetamine, is a reversible inhibitor of monoamine oxidase A (MAO-A), thereby being a RIMA, and, to a lesser extent, semicarbazide-sensitive amine oxidase (SSAO) inhibitor, as well as a serotonin releasing agent (SRA). It is a derivative of the phenethylamine and amphetamine families. The (+)-enantiomer is the active stereoisomer.

pharmacology.text: Amiflamine (developmental code name FLA-336), also known (S)-2-methyl-4-(dimethylamino)amphetamine, is a reversible inhibitor of monoamine oxidase A (MAO-A), thereby being a RIMA, and, to a lesser extent, semicarbazide-sensitive amine oxidase (SSAO) inhibitor, as well as a serotonin releasing agent (SRA).

uses.text: In other words, at low doses, it can be used to selectively inhibit MAO-A enzymes in serotonin cells, whereas at higher doses it loses its selectivity.

summaryZh: 阿米夫胺（INN：amiflamine；開發代號：FLA-336）是單胺氧化酶A的可逆抑制劑，對氨基脲敏感性胺氧化酶也有一定抑制作用，並且是血清素釋放劑。它是苯乙胺和安非他明的衍生物。該化合物的-對映體是活性立體異構體。
summaryZhHans: 阿米夫胺（INN：amiflamine；开发代号：FLA-336）是单胺氧化酶A的可逆抑制剂，对氨基脲敏感性胺氧化酶也有一定抑制作用，并且是血清素释放剂。它是苯乙胺和安非他明的衍生物。该化合物的-对映体是活性立体异构体。

sideEffects.en: It was never marketed, so its effects in people are not well documented. Reversible MAO-A inhibitors as a class can cause nausea, headache, dizziness and sleep problems, and drugs that raise serotonin carry a risk of serotonin syndrome.
sideEffects.zh: 它從未上市，因此對人體的作用紀錄不多。可逆性 MAO-A 抑制劑作為一類，可能造成噁心、頭痛、頭暈與睡眠問題，而提高血清素的藥物都有血清素症候群的風險。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它从未上市，因此对人体的作用纪录不多。可逆性 MAO-A 抑制剂作为一类，可能造成恶心、头痛、头晕与睡眠问题，而提高血清素的药物都有血清素症候群的风险。

fact.en: It is an amphetamine that was turned into an antidepressant: adding methyl and dimethylamino groups to the ring largely removed the stimulant effect and left a reversible block of monoamine oxidase A.
fact.zh: 阿米夫胺是被改造成抗憂鬱劑的安非他命：在苯環上加入甲基與二甲胺基後，興奮作用大致消失，留下對單胺氧化酶 A 的可逆性阻斷。
fact.zhHans: 阿米夫胺是被改造成抗忧郁剂的安非他命：在苯环上加入甲基与二甲胺基后，兴奋作用大致消失，留下对单胺氧化酶 A 的可逆性阻断。
